Procedural RGB test image, 35x19, quality 83, three chroma subsamplings, baseline and progressive. Encoded with Pillow; reference RGBA decoded by the unchanged C++ layoutng::SkiaImageDecoder linked to the existing Skia/libjpeg-turbo build. Generator: artifacts/live-bilibili-fidelity (image_decode_native.cc). No website content or golden pixels enter production decoding.
Right-edge regressions: procedural RGB, 38x19, quality 83, 4:2:2 and 4:2:0, baseline/progressive. The even width exposes the final odd output sample where MCU padding must be replaced by the actual image edge. Pixel(x,y)=((47*x+13*y)%256,(7*x+53*y)%256,(61*x+29*y)%256). Same native reference decoder.
